event.actionhandlerdesc: Add custom operations to the alarm.
event.applyhandlerdesc: Assign the alarm to handlers or teams. Handlers and users in assigned teams can update the alarm status, close the alarm, or delete the alarm.
event.cancelintervalhandlerdesc: Cancel scheduled jobs created by scheduled dispatch plugins in the current alarm type.
event.closehandlerdesc: Closed alarms cannot be modified, and new alarms will no longer be mounted under closed alarms.
event.conditionhandlerdesc: Trigger other event plugins conditionally through configured condition groups, such as sending notifications or assigning handlers.
event.deletehandlerdesc: Physically delete alarm information. Deleted alarms cannot be restored. Use with caution.
event.emailhandlerdesc: Send email through SMTP. Mail server information must be configured in System Administration, and recipient email addresses cannot be empty.
event.integrationhandlerdesc: Call RESTful APIs of third-party systems.
event.intervalhandlerdesc: Configure time policies to delay or periodically call other event plugins, such as sending notifications or assigning handlers.
event.markhandlerdesc: Add custom tags to the alarm. Existing tags remain unchanged.
event.openhandlerdesc: Reopen a closed alarm. If the alarm is already open, this event will not be triggered.
event.savehandlerdesc: Save the alarm to the database. If there is an unclosed alarm with the same Unique Key, it will be automatically mounted as a sub alarm.
event.unactionhandlerdesc: Remove custom operations that are already associated with the alarm.
event.updatehandlerdesc: Update the alarm status. If the alarm status does not change, this event will not be executed.
